name: Icejade Ran Tremora
desc: If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Icejade" monster from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Icejade Token" (Aqua/WATER/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). If a face-up WATER monster(s) you control leave the field by your opponent's card while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Icejade Ran Tremora" once per turn.
strings: Special Summon this card from your hand
Send 1 "Icejade" monster from your Deck to the GY, then Special Summon 1 "Icejade Token"
Special Summon this card from your GY
